ast.source: The delimiter to generate the number prefix/suffix for duplicated names. For example, if the value is "-", the suffix will be like "-1", "-2", "-3", and the prefix will be like "1-", "2-", "3-". Only characters that are valid in file names are allowed.
ast.target: 用來產生重複名稱編號前綴或後綴的分隔符號。例如值為「-」時，後綴會是「-1」、「-2」、「-3」，前綴則會是「1-」、「2-」、「3-」。僅能使用檔名允許的字元。

ast.source: If enabled, duplicate number will always be added to the image name. Otherwise, it will only be added when the name is duplicated.
ast.target: 啟用後，一律在圖片名稱加入重複編號；否則只在名稱重複時加入。

ast.source: By default, the rename modal will always be shown to confirm before renaming, if this option is set, the image will be auto renamed after pasting.
ast.target: 預設會顯示重新命名對話視窗以供確認。啟用此選項後，圖片會在貼上後自動重新命名。

ast.source:
By default, the plugin only handles images that starts with "Pasted image " in name,
			which is the prefix Obsidian uses to create images from pasted content.
			If this option is set, the plugin will handle all attachments that are created in the vault.
ast.target:
預設僅處理名稱以「Pasted image 」開頭的圖片，這是 Obsidian 從貼上內容建立圖片時使用的前綴。
			啟用此選項後，插件會處理儲存庫中建立的所有附件。

ast.source:
This option is only useful when "Handle all attachments" is enabled.
			Write a Regex pattern to exclude certain extensions from being handled. Only the first line will be used.
ast.target:
此選項僅在啟用「處理所有附件」時有效。
			輸入 Regex 模式以排除特定副檔名；只會使用第一行。

ast.source:
Turn off this option if you don't want to see the notice when renaming images.
			Note that Obsidian may display a notice when a link has changed, this option cannot disable that.
ast.target:
若不想在重新命名圖片時看到通知，請啟用此選項。
			請注意，Obsidian 可能仍會在連結變更時顯示通知，此選項無法停用該通知。

ast.source:
The pattern indicates how the new name should be generated.

Available variables:
- {{fileName}}: name of the active file, without ".md" extension.
- {{imageNameKey}}: this variable is read from the markdown file's frontmatter, from the same key "imageNameKey".
- {{DATE:$FORMAT}}: use "$FORMAT" to format the current date, "$FORMAT" must be a Moment.js format string, e.g. {{DATE:YYYY-MM-DD}}.

Here are some examples from pattern to image names (repeat in sequence), variables: fileName = "My note", imageNameKey = "foo":
- {{fileName}}: My note, My note-1, My note-2
- {{imageNameKey}}: foo, foo-1, foo-2
- {{imageNameKey}}-{{DATE:YYYYMMDD}}: foo-20220408, foo-20220408-1, foo-20220408-2
ast.target:
此模式用來決定如何產生新名稱。

可用變數：
- {{fileName}}：目前檔案的名稱，不含「.md」副檔名。
- {{imageNameKey}}：從 Markdown 檔案的 Frontmatter 讀取同名的「imageNameKey」欄位。
- {{DATE:$FORMAT}}：使用「$FORMAT」格式化目前日期；格式必須是 Moment.js 格式字串，例如 {{DATE:YYYY-MM-DD}}。

以下是模式轉換成圖片名稱的範例（依序重複），變數為 fileName =「My note」、imageNameKey =「foo」：
- {{fileName}}：My note、My note-1、My note-2
- {{imageNameKey}}：foo、foo-1、foo-2
- {{imageNameKey}}-{{DATE:YYYYMMDD}}：foo-20220408、foo-20220408-1、foo-20220408-2
